goal: In scaffold/agent/stability_gate.py add a one-line docstring to should_check explaining it gates scaffold evolution checks by session count

lines.content: """Gates scaffold evolution checks by session count."""

files.unified_diff:
--- scaffold/agent/stability_gate.py (before)
+++ scaffold/agent/stability_gate.py (after)
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def should_check(self, session_count: int) -> bool:

-        """True every `check_every` sessions."""

+        """Gates scaffold evolution checks by session count."""

         return session_count > 0 and (session_count % self.check_every == 0)
